grant_text: Proceed with recommendations and option b as a standing permission as proposed.
scope: Weekly renewal of alert reference bands (low, high, invalidation, reference_confidence) for the evaluated scope, via scripts/weekly_band_renewal.py and the gated scripts/g6_yahoo32_sql_apply.py.
auto_apply_only_when_all_hold: every evaluated name computes (no blocked names)
zero invalidation-ordering warnings (invalidation strictly below band low)
dry run against live canon reports zero drift and no mutation
no band edge (low, high, invalidation) moves more than 5% for any name
otherwise: stop, write the review packet, and surface to Randall for a per-batch decision
every_run_produces: on apply: sqlite backup, rollback record, content-addressed successor pin in state/finance/baselines, baseline freshness guard result
rollback: python scripts/g6_yahoo32_sql_apply.py --rollback --db state/finance/finance-canon.sqlite --rollback-path <rollback record from the audit>
not_granted: methodology or formula changes (new band_methodology_version needs owner approval)
adding or removing names from scope
capital, orders, accounts, execution, external delivery

amendments.grant_text: Proceed with all three recommendations, continue and prepare to remove the static 32-name list
amendments.recommendation_approved: Implement a gated fix for the stale reference_band_status label in the renewal writer, with its own proof and rollback.
amendments.effect: Each applied renewal also sets reference_band_status to NULL for the renewed rows only. The prior labels are recorded in the rollback record's before_rows and restored by the byte-exact backup on rollback. The column is a point-in-time price observation, not a band edge; readers compute status from live price.
amendments.does_not_change: auto-apply conditions, band methodology, the numeric baseline pin, names in scope, or anything in not_granted

amendments.grant_text: Add a rule that the renewal stops for your review whenever the name list has changed since the last applied renewal.
amendments.effect: Adds a fifth auto-apply condition: the renewed name list must equal the name list of the last applied renewal. If it differs, or no prior applied renewal can be read, the run stops at needs_owner_review and writes the review packet. A newly promoted name's first band therefore never auto-applies, and neither does the first renewal after a demotion.
amendments.additional_auto_apply_condition: renewed name list equals the last applied renewal's name list (added and removed names both stop the run)
amendments.enforced_by: scripts/weekly_band_renewal.py once lane PHASE4-DYNAMIC-SCOPE-20260927 slice 1a is accepted. Until then the matrix generator's hard-coded 32-name list means the renewed list cannot change, so the condition holds trivially.
amendments.does_not_change: the four original conditions, names in scope, band methodology, or anything in not_granted

revocation: Randall says so; set active=false. The weekly job then always stops at review.
